newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish car registrations rise 16 pct. [CORRECTED 9:03 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Swedish car registrations rise 16 pct. [CORRECTED 9:03 GMT]

text.p: Swedish car registrations rose to 17,030 cars in September, a 16 percent increase on the same month in 1995, Statistics Sweden said on Wednesday.
It said new car registrations for the first nine months of the year had increased just over eight percent to 137,472.

Truck registrations had increased by 51 percent in September to 1,783, Statistics Sweden said, for a 43 percent increase to 4,434 for the first nine months of the year. (Corrects figures for January to September following correction issued by Statistics Sweden).
